module: Development tool that sorts, by "name" field, the sound JSON files of a level. These files contain one JSON object per line ("JSON lines" format) in /levels/<level>/main/MissionGroup/Audio/. handleLevel walks the *.json files of this folder and handleFile rewrites each file with its lines sorted by name. It modifies files in place.
notes: Overwrites the original file (io.open(path, 'w')) with no backup; use it on a working copy.
Empty lines are removed on rewrite. Each line is decoded with jsonDecode; lines without a name field are sorted with the empty name (first).

Probable bug: the gmatch('([^\n]*)\n?') pattern produces a last empty string when the file ends with a line break; jsonDecode('') does not return a table, and obj.name would then cause a Lua error (indexing nil).
table.sort is not stable: the relative order of lines with the same name is not guaranteed.

handleFile.desc: Reads a JSON lines file, sorts the lines by their name field (ascending order) and rewrites the file.

path.desc: Path of the file to sort.

handleLevel.desc: Sorts all the *.json files (non-recursive) of the /levels/<level>/main/MissionGroup/Audio/ folder.
